message: The other day, I was trying to explain the importance of smoke alarms to my kids, who were more interested in their video games than fire safety. After a few eye-rolls, I decided to turn it into a game—who could draw the best escape plan for the house? Turns out, my youngest made a pretty elaborate route that even included a detour for snacks! It was a fun way to chat about safety without it feeling like a lecture. Sometimes, a little creativity can make the serious stuff stick. How do you keep safety discussions fun with your kids?
